utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, what’s the repair drive still need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly tools and a few hands to sort donations. I’m heading out later, so I can check what’s still missing and bring back an update.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. Can you let me know which tools are still missing when you get back?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — that’d really help. I’ll swing by when I can and see what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah—just let me know what you’re missing when you stop by, and we’ll get you set up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s meant to help folks with small home fixes and such—pretty handy if you’ve got a few things piling up. I can find out more if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds useful, but I’d want to know when it is and who’s organizing it before I sign up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can check those details for you—I'll find out when it is and who’s organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you swing by the repair drive at the community center on Maple Street and help sort donations? If you can, be there around 3.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can be there around 3 and help sort the donations at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, the repair drive’s coming up soon—want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’m not sure I can commit yet, but I appreciate you asking.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — no pressure at all. I’ll keep you in the loop in case your schedule opens up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive. What’s the first thing you want us to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — let’s start by listing the repairs people need, then we can sort them by urgency.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — I’ll start gathering the repair requests and note how urgent each one is.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the time, place, and what kind of repairs you need? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m late to the drive, but I can send the details now. It’s at the community center, and I need help with a leaky faucet and a loose cabinet door.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ve got the community center, a leaky faucet, and a loose cabinet door. What time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times, so just let me know when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Faye — thank you. I’ll send you the repair drive time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — once you have the time, I’ll work around the school schedule and keep things flexible.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Nell, I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it feels good to help out together. Do you want to grab supplies first or head over and see what’s needed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’d rather head over and see what’s needed first. Then I can grab the right supplies after.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ve got the basics covered, or do you still need a list from me?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got the basics covered, but a list would help me double-check.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m listening—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy, but I think folks are bringing in tools and supplies; I can check and tell you what I’ve seen.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. If you check, just let me know what’s actually coming in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supply list and make sure we have what people need when they come by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll remind people to bring any tools they can spare and I’ll let them know where to check in when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm still a little fuzzy on the details, but I'm happy to help if you tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll circle back with the list of what still needs fixing and the plan for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Vik—just send it over when you have it, and I’ll pitch in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details; what’s the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re just collecting small appliance and bike repairs this Saturday at the community center. Bring anything broken by 10 and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Saturday at the community center by 10. I’ll bring the little lamp that’s been acting up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: bring the screwdriver set, a hammer, and some tape, and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the screwdriver set, a hammer, and some tape. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—can you send a quick note to your block and ask folks to bring gloves, tools, and any spare paint? I’ll keep the invites moving too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll send a quick note to my block asking for gloves, tools, and any spare paint. Thanks for keeping the invites moving too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help keep folks in the loop for the repair drive—just tell me what you need shared, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — please share that the repair drive is at the community center on Maple Street, and folks can drop by between 10 and 2.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that the repair drive is at the community center on Maple Street, from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Let’s make sure Cleo has what she needs to help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rosa — I’ll check our supplies and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — thank you. Send me the list when you can, and I’ll line up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for filling me in — I’m still catching up on the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still collecting repair requests and lining up volunteers. Do you need help with a specific item?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I might, yeah — I’ve got a wobbly cabinet door and maybe a loose porch step. Who should I tell?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in — just point me to the details and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send over the repair drive details and the school timing once I have them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send it when you’ve got it, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure you can make it? I just need confirmation on what you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can make it. I’ll bring some tools and a few supplies—just tell me if you need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s happening soon, but I’m still piecing together the details. What do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not much more than you, I’m afraid — I just know it’s coming up soon and folks are trying to get the details sorted. If I hear anything useful, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. I’ll keep asking around too and see if I can learn more.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start by checking which homes need the most urgent repairs, then I can make a list of locations for us.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds good—I can help check in with folks and note any urgent issues. Once you have the list, I’ll start reaching out to the homes that need attention first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what’s already on hand and what still needs to be bought?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supplies list and confirm what we already have versus what still needs to be bought.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to add your name to the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, please add me to the invite list. I’d love to help spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add your name right now, and thank you for helping spread the word while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help out. What do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’m trying to keep it simple. We mainly need a couple of volunteers, a box of basic tools, and a plan for who handles pickups.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take one pickup slot and bring my basic tools. If you want, I can also help make a quick volunteer list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you share the date, time, and location, plus who people should contact if they want to volunteer?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send me the details and I’ll pass them along to my groups. I can include the date, time, location, and volunteer contact in one message.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m putting the repair drive list together now—if you’ve got any homes or small fixes to add, send them my way. I’ll make sure we keep it organized and get everyone covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got a couple small fixes I can send over. I’ll text you the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Rey — send them whenever you’re ready and I’ll add them to the list. We’ll keep it moving and make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the repair drive. I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I can ask around and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that — I’m just trying to keep track of what’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Eli, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, we’re still on. Let’s keep the same plan and meet at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll see you at the usual time then. Do you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I haven’t seen the details yet—what’s the repair drive asking for?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly tools, spare parts, and a few volunteers to help sort and fix things up. I can check the list and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, please send the list when you can—I can probably help if it’s not too much.
